description: The alternative explanations a perturbation result must survive. Each carries the cheap check that would separate it from the claimed effect, because an unfalsifiable confounder list is a literature review, not an audit.

confounders.question: Is treatment confounded with batch, lane, or sequencing run?
confounders.cheap_test: cross-tabulate the perturbation against every technical level; a zero cell means the two cannot be separated

confounders.question: Do the compared groups differ in sequencing depth or detected features?
confounders.cheap_test: compare median UMI and gene counts per group before interpreting any difference

confounders.question: Is guide assignment itself associated with the outcome through capture efficiency?
confounders.cheap_test: check assignment rate and multiplet rate by group

confounders.question: Could multiplets or high MOI create apparent double perturbations?
confounders.cheap_test: report doublet rate and per-cell guide counts

confounders.question: Is the signal explainable by ambient RNA from a dominant population?
confounders.cheap_test: check whether the moving genes are the high-expressers of the majority population

confounders.question: Is the response a cell-cycle shift rather than the claimed pathway?
confounders.cheap_test: score cell-cycle phase and re-test with phase as a covariate

confounders.question: Is this a generic stress, apoptosis, or viability signature?
confounders.cheap_test: score a generic stress signature; if it moves as much as the claimed pathway, the claim is not specific

confounders.question: Did cell-state composition shift rather than per-state expression?
confounders.cheap_test: re-run within state, or decompose the change into composition and within-state parts

confounders.question: Did the perturbation change which cells survived to be sequenced?
confounders.cheap_test: compare cells recovered per condition against the input distribution

confounders.question: Is the effect off-target rather than through the intended gene?
confounders.cheap_test: require agreement across independent guides, and check on-target knockdown

confounders.question: Was the pathway defined using the same data now used to support it?
confounders.cheap_test: check the provenance of the gene set against the dataset

confounders.question: Does the effect reverse across cell type, dose, time, or assay?
confounders.cheap_test: look for the same contrast in any second context before claiming generality

required_negative_controls.why: separates the perturbation from the delivery
separates a specific response from a general one
separates a real effect from the pipeline's own structure

computability_note: `computable_by` names the tool that decides this confounder from the data. Where it is present the sweep gate takes the tool's verdict and refuses a bundle that asserts a different one — the author does not get to grade their own alternative explanation. Where it is absent the confounder genuinely needs information outside the matrix (a guide library, an off-target prediction, how the gene set was defined), so an asserted result is the best available and the receipt records that it was asserted.
